outcome: establishment of link with cerebral palsy
cohort: Term deliveries of singleton pregnancies diagnosed with at least 1 hour of abnormal fetal heart rate
finding: The intra- and interobserver agreement among obstetric experts in court regarding the review of abnormal fetal heart rate tracing and the appropriateness of obstetrical care is poor, suggesting a lack of objectivity in current practices of obstetrical expertise in legal settings.
mod_finding: The experts were significantly more likely to agree with the mode of delivery (P < .001) when informed about the neonatal outcome.
